settings.title: K5 Vehicle Integration
settings.description: Enables climate, seats, vehicle information, radio, Comfort and CarPlay volume/media popup replacement. Keeps native popups outside CarPlay.

settings.title: Seat Heating Immediate Feedback
settings.description: Echo requested heating state immediately before BCM reconciliation. Enabled preserves existing heating behavior. Disable only for diagnosis.

settings.title: Legacy Heated Seat Compatibility (Experimental)
settings.description: Restore RC5/RC6 heated-seat level precedence and cached-level selection. Retains current ventilation feedback and session safety checks. Requires K5 Vehicle Integration.

settings.title: Seat Ventilation Immediate Feedback (Experimental)
settings.description: Echo requested ventilation characteristics immediately, then reconcile with confirmed vehicle feedback. Off waits for BCM confirmation. Requires K5 Vehicle Integration.

settings.title: CarPlay Ultra
settings.description: Enables the consolidated Ultra capabilities, virtual cluster, DBX variant, extended features, LIVI display metadata and receiver version 950.7.1.

settings.title: Enable Ultra Sidebars
settings.description: Enables theme identity, CarPlayStartSession and themed display IDs for native vehicle apps and Ultra sidebars. Requires CarPlay Ultra.

settings.title: UI Synchronization
settings.description: Enables Ultra layout and palette synchronization. Both displays use phone-managed choices. Requires Ultra Sidebars. Theme selector remains experimental.

settings.title: Independent UI Sync Negotiation (Experimental)
settings.description: Allows offered UI Sync even when vehicleStateProtocol is not offered, preserving the stock enabled features. Requires UI Synchronization and Ultra Sidebars. Off retains legacy negotiation.

settings.title: Widescreen View Areas (Experimental)
settings.description: Independent of Ultra Sidebars. Adds whole and right-hand view areas where supported; existing OEM/PPS view areas are preserved. Restart required.

settings.title: SiriusXM Discovery
settings.description: Advertises an experimental SiriusXM source with OEM catalog and eligible channel tuning. Requires vehicle validation; no entitlement changes.

settings.title: Parked AirPlay Video & Audio
settings.description: Experimental video with sound while safely parked. Stops when Park confirmation is lost.

settings.title: AirPlay Picture Only (Diagnostic)
settings.description: Disables the local AirPlay audio renderer from the start to isolate video decoding and rendering. Requires Parked AirPlay Video & Audio. All Park safety checks remain active.

settings.title: Automatic Session Logging
settings.description: Retain bounded persistent logs independently of HMG-API rotation.

settings.title: Automatic USB Session Export
settings.description: Export completed session logs to USB when available.

settings.title: Detailed Session Diagnostics
settings.description: Collect additional climate, radio, SiriusXM, audio, theme and AirPlay diagnostics together. Saved in bounded session logs and exported to USB. Turn off for normal daily use if desired.

settings.title: Protocol Packet Diagnostics
settings.description: Include additional vehicle services and projection packet metadata (types, sizes and stream events only; never raw payloads). Enable only for targeted protocol testing.
